rules: Unknown owner/case/fileclass/parent: typed HOLD; never use root or fallback.
Caller must provide current parent metadata and the expected owner basis; local checks do not establish authority or freshness.

The handoff payload must contain the exact original owner-home URL above; its pointer is also returned in the local plan receipt.
Unknown write outcome means reconcile the same logical artifact before any further write; never retry automatically.
Release recipient link only after exact file ID, MIME type, and sole expected parent are read back; content readback remains separate.
